title: Writer Assistant Core BookNLP adapter contract implementation and mocked normalization foundation
goal: Publish the implementation parent that satisfies the expected-red BookNLP adapter contract from PHASE8-IMPL-006 by implementing pure mocked backend/story_knowledge/booknlp_adapter_contract.py. Begin with a read-only official source inventory child using the already-cloned .external_sources/ repositories before any implementation.
why_now: PHASE8-IMPL-006 closed the evidence-first extraction foundation and BookNLP-ready adapter strategy with an intentional expected-red future handoff for backend.story_knowledge.booknlp_adapter_contract. The owner has now cloned the official source repositories into local read-only .external_sources/ directories, so a read-only source inventory child should run before implementation. The next safe parent therefore begins with that inventory and then implements the pure mocked adapter contract.

t003_booknlp_adapter_implementation_deci.raw_vs_normalized_decision: Raw BookNLP-like fixture shapes should use T002-confirmed source names where practical; adapter-normalized records and candidate drafts may use app-owned source_locator, confidence, raw_output_refs, normalization_status, candidate_type, target_category, evidence, and provenance fields.
t003_booknlp_adapter_implementation_deci.fixture_correction_policy: T004 may make minimal contract-test fixture corrections only if needed to align tests with T002 verified source inventory, especially to clarify booknlp_events as app-derived from .tokens.event. T004 must not delete safety tests, weaken boundaries, change public API names, or add real BookNLP dependencies.
t003_booknlp_adapter_implementation_deci.event_derivation_policy: booknlp_events is app-owned derived support from .tokens.event, not a raw BookNLP output file.
t003_booknlp_adapter_implementation_deci.offset_policy: BookNLP byte offsets are raw support only; app-owned source locators/evidence are required for successful candidate drafts. Full byte-to-character mapping against real source snapshots is deferred.
t003_booknlp_adapter_implementation_deci.identity_guardrail: .book g is raw aggregate metadata only and must not be treated as gender identity.
t003_booknlp_adapter_implementation_deci.coreference_quote_guardrail: Coreference clusters, quote attribution, and event flags remain candidate evidence only and must fail closed when ambiguous.

context_tools_policy: No context tools, CCE, Graphify, Repomix, AI Context, MCP tools, or LeanCTX were run in T007.
external_tool_policy: T007 did not install packages, clone/fetch/pull repositories, retrieve web sources, run BookNLP, run spaCy, run dramatica-flow, run NCP tooling, run model calls, run Ollama, or execute external tools.
external_sources_policy: .external_sources/ is a local read-only evidence cache for T002, not an app dependency. .external_sources/ must not be committed, must not be staged, must not be vendored into backend/, must not be copied into app runtime files, must not be executed, and must not be imported. candidate_only_policy: Tool outputs and imported structural data remain candidates with evidence/provenance until explicit owner approval. No candidate can mutate memory/canon automatically. Candidate drafts from build_booknlp_candidate_drafts are not persisted and not promoted in this parent.
mocked_booknlp_policy: BookNLP-like outputs in this parent are mocked fixtures only. Real BookNLP install/run remains deferred. Adapter implementation must not import or execute BookNLP.
source_evidence_policy: Source locators, stable source maps, source hashes, evidence spans, raw output provenance, and candidate normalization must be decided before runtime extraction begins. The existing pure source-map and evidence validation helpers in backend/story_knowledge/source_map.py and backend/story_knowledge/evidence.py remain the foundation for this parent's adapter normalization boundaries.
